description: This file defines the VTEntityMethodManager class, which manages entity methods within the vtiger CRM workflow module. It includes methods to add, execute, and list methods associated with different modules, interacting with the database via an $adb object.

classes.name: VTEntityMethodManager
classes.description: A class to handle CRUD operations and execution of entity methods tied to specific modules in the vtiger CRM workflow system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with a database connection object ($adb).

methods.name: addEntityMethod
methods.description: Adds a new entity method record into the database for a given module with method details.

methods.name: executeMethod
methods.description: Executes a stored entity method by retrieving its function path and name from the database, then requiring the file and calling the function.

methods.name: methodsForModule
methods.description: Returns a list of method names associated with a specific module.
